rationale: The bag was lost by the carrier during the covered trip, the loss was reported to Meridian Air and its report and settlement letter are on file, so section 5 (Baggage and Personal Effects) applies. Applying the Premium per-item limit of $300, with the tuxedo and the dress shirts-and-trousers set each counted as one item and the camera counted with its lens as one item, the eligible total is $1,550; less the carrier's $350 payment and the $50 deductible, and within the $1,500 benefit maximum, the payout is $1,150 (section 10 / manual section 6). Because that payout is over $1,000 it needs claims handler sign-off before payment (manual section 3).
